types:
  PaginatedResponseLinks:
    properties:
      next: optional<string>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  PaginatedResponse:
    properties:
      data: optional<list<string>>
      links: optional<PaginatedResponseLinks>
      total_count: optional<integer>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml

comments.yml.rawContents:
imports:
  root: __package__.yml
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    index:
      path: /comments
      method: GET
      docs: ''
      pagination:
        cursor: $request.page
        next_cursor: $response.links.next
        results: $response.data
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      display-name: List comments
      request:
        name: CommentsIndexRequest
        query-parameters:
          page: optional<string>
      response:
        docs: Success
        type: root.PaginatedResponse
        status-code: 200
      examples:
        - response:
            body:
              data:
                - data
              links:
                next: next
              total_count: 1
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
